{#- Version switcher for the Furo sidebar, populated by sphinx-polyversion. conf.py's load() puts two values into the template namespace: * current -- the GitRef of the version being rendered * revisions -- all built versions (GitRef namedtuples: .name, .date, ...) Both are absent on a plain `make html` build, so nothing is rendered then. Rendered as a native {%- for rev in revisions | sort(attribute='name') %} {%- endfor %} {%- endif %}
